nodes.label: Clean Architecture Pattern
nodes.rationale: main.py is router only; business_logic.py holds all logic and never calls the database directly; database_manager.py owns all CRUD and connection handling; strict layering keeps concerns separated and maintainable.

nodes.label: Configuration Caching
nodes.rationale: 5-minute in-memory cache of configuration values in business_logic.py to reduce repeated database queries; invalidated on config updates.

nodes.label: Recurring Payments Widget Configuration Design
nodes.rationale: Selected category IDs are stored as a JSON array under the Configuration table key recurring_payment_categories (consistent with the currency_format storage pattern) rather than a DB schema change, because it is a user preference, not a connection setting; empty selection defaults to monitoring all expense categories for backward compatibility.

nodes.label: htmx Auto-Save UX
nodes.rationale: htmx is used so saving and reloading happen automatically without redirecting the user to the top of the page or losing context; UX is called out as critical.

nodes.label: Formula Parsing Validation Rules
nodes.rationale: Only simple addition formulas (e.g. =575+2182) are accepted; IF/SUM/complex formulas, negatives and multiplication are rejected to keep imported transaction amounts unambiguous and safe.

nodes.label: Import Payee Marking Pattern
nodes.rationale: All imported transactions are tagged with an auto-created 'Import - Google Sheets' payee so users can easily identify and review imported data.

nodes.label: 3-Column Widget Grid Layout
nodes.rationale: Bootstrap col-lg-4 grid chosen so the dashboard can expand to 4-6 widgets by adding more columns without restructuring the layout.

nodes.label: Budget Progress Color Logic (green/red)
nodes.rationale: Green bars indicate under-budget (percentage < 100%), red bars indicate at/over budget, with an 'Over by X' text shown only when over budget, giving users an at-a-glance status signal.

nodes.label: Google Sheets Import TDD Implementation Plan
nodes.norm_label: google sheets import tdd implementation plan

nodes.label: Transaction Wrapping (@with_transaction)
nodes.rationale: All write operations wrapped with @with_transaction to guarantee atomicity, automatic rollback on error, and automatic retry on transient OperationalErrors, while ValueError/IntegrityError fail immediately.

nodes.label: Import Functionality Refactoring Design
nodes.rationale: Import functionality (~500 lines Python, ~380 lines JS) was used on only one page but embedded in core modules; extracting it into import_logic.py and static/js/import.js shrinks business_logic.py (-580 lines) and app.js (-380 lines), isolates seldom-used code, and lets the import page skip loading unused JS on other pages.
